item.text: [{"task_id":"c074846d","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    red = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    pivot = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    green = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    a = int(round(params['rotation'][0]))","    b = int(round(params['rotation'][1]))","    c = int(round(params['rotation'][2]))","    d = int(round(params['rotation'][3]))","    out = grid.copy()","    centers = np.argwhere(grid == pivot)","    if len(centers) == 0:","        return out","    pr, pc = centers[0]","    cells = np.argwhere(grid == red)","    for r, col in cells:","        out[r, col] = green","    for r, col in cells:","        dr = r - pr","        dc = col - pc","        nr = pr + a * dr + b * dc","        nc = pc + c * dr + d * dc","        if 0 <= nr < grid.shape[0] and 0 <= nc < grid.shape[1]:","            out[nr, nc] = red","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"rotation":[4]},"params":{"colors":[2,5,3],"rotation":[0,1,-1,0]},"rationale":"Recolor the original red arm green, then copy its red cells through a clockwise quarter-turn around the gray pivot. The tensors encode the three colors and the rotation matrix."}]
